title: screenshot / record_video write to any path (record_video can overwrite with force)
reason: Absolute paths and '../' are accepted as-is, so a steered model can write or (with force=true) overwrite any file the user can write, e.g. ~/.zshrc, with image/video bytes.
fix: Resolve the path and require it to stay inside a configured output folder (default ~/Downloads); drop the force flag or require confirmation.

title: Accessibility text from the simulator returned raw to the model
reason: ui_describe_all returns all on-screen labels/text (which can include web or app content written by others) unmarked into the model context, and the same server has shell-reaching tools above.
fix: Mark the output as untrusted data; fixing F001-F004/M001-M002 removes the dangerous follow-up.
